Bundled Windows x64 libmpv (LGPL), fetched by scripts/package-windows.sh.

Source: https://github.com/mpv-player/mpv/releases/tag/git-release
Asset pattern: libmpv-*-x86_64-w64-mingw32-lgpl.zip

DramaRed dynamically loads libmpv-2.dll (P/Invoke); it is not statically linked.
The binary itself is gitignored; LICENSE.LGPL is kept in-tree.
